subject: AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF HUNGARY
text:
U1340/26 NOTAMR U0865/26
Q)UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03716E999
A)UUUU B)2610010709 C)2701012359 EST
E)AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF HUNGARY
STIPULATING THAT ALL AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN RUSSIAN FEDERATION AND
ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY ANY RUSSIAN NATURAL
OR LEGAL PERSON AND ALL OPERATORS HOLDING OPERATING LICENCE (OL)
OR ITS EQUIVALENT ISSUED BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES,
INCLUDING COMMERCIAL AIR CARRIERS, ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER/EXIT OR
OVERFLY HUNGARIAN AIRSPACE, AS PER AIP SUP 002/2026,
AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM THAT ALL
AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN HUNGARY AND ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED
OR OPERATED BY ANY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSON OF HUNGARY, AIR
CARRIERS HOLDING OL OR ITS EQUIVALENT ISSUED BY HUNGARIAN
AUTHORITIES, INCLUDING COMMERCIAL AIR CARRIERS, ARE PROHIBITED TO
ENTER/EXIT OR OVERFLY AIRSPACE OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION, EXCEPT FOR
AIRCRAFT IN EMERGENCY, HUMANITARIAN FLIGHTS, AMBULANCE FLIGHTS AND
CASES WHEN SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR FLT OPS IS GRANTED BY FEDERAL AIR
TRANSPORT AGENCY OR MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF RUSSIAN
FEDERATION, AS APPROPRIATE.
